messages:
avery: Heads-up: ran into JS vs Py discrepancy when using function-calling + json_mode. JS helper throws on some model outputs that have tiny trailing garbage; Py helper parses fine.

lina: Versions? streaming?

avery: sdk-js@1.8.2 and sdk-py@1.8.2, non-streaming. Model returned arguments like: '{"id":"X12","qty":1}
OK' (trailing 
OK). JS JSON.parse fails, py regex extractor picks out the JSON.

devon: Sounds like our sanitize helper is too aggressive in JS. It tries to trim and repair but can accidentally remove braces. We should never drop a closing '}' automatically.

maria.devex: Short term: instruct the model to return ONLY JSON inside a single ```json block``` or use a permissive parser. Medium term: add parseStrict/rawParse APIs to JS helper and add unit tests with stubbed raw bytes.

avery: I'll open a mini repro server and file an issue with raw http bodies.

runtime-bot: runtime-bot: added debug flag to log raw_response_body behind FEATURE_FLAG_JSON_DEBUG.

maria.devex: I'll PR sanitize.js changes + tests and docs note about json_mode caveats.

avery: Issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/477 — attaching repro. Thanks all!
